name: BroadbandNet
summary: Perth fixed-wireless broadband ISP (BroadbandNet Pty Ltd, ACN 105 565 222, founded 17 Jul 2003, MD Andrew Winterburn); started as a division of WestNet; administration ~Oct/Nov 2008; IIPC (Intelligent IP) acquired the network + customer base Dec 2008, rebranded as Intelligent IP Broadband (IIPB).

events.details: Administration Oct/Nov 2008; network + customers acquired by IIPC (Intelligent IP).
